name: Temple Street, Eastern End
desc1: The crowd is quite dense here, as the town square is to the east,
desc2: attracting people with its produce and items. A massive stone building
desc3: is to the north, and you can hear the sound of ringing coming from
desc4: within its open door. A sign with and anvil and the words "Skali's
desc5: Armour" hangs over the door. To the south, the thick doors of the city
desc6: bank stand wedged open. Guards stand at the entrance, with halberd and
desc7: mail, ever vigilant. Temple street leads off to the west here.
